# Super Mutants
◈ Super Mutants ◈ FEV Mutants ◈ Wendover Region ◈
◈ FACTION DOSSIER ◈
[bold]Status:[/bold] Active - Scattered
[bold]Location:[/bold] Bonneville Salt Flats, Common Wealth Wasteland Ruins
[bold]Commander:[/bold] N/A - Individual
[bold]Ideology:[/bold] Strength Above All
[bold]Motto:[/bold] [italic]Humans weak. Super Mutants strong.[/italic]
[bold]Affiliation:[/bold] Independent
⬜ RESTRICTED ACCESS ⬜
[bold]Super Mutants[/bold] are humans who were exposed to the [bold]Forced Evolutionary Virus (FEV)[/bold] - a pre-war biological agent designed to create the perfect soldier. The virus transformed them into massive, green-skinned creatures of immense physical power and near-total radiation immunity. The cost was severe: most lost higher cognitive function, becoming violent and territorial. Some, however, retained their intelligence - and with it, their capacity for choice.
## Physical Characteristics
[bold]1.5× human scale[/bold] - visually and physically larger than any human
Extreme physical strength and resilience
Near-total radiation immunity
Greatly extended lifespan (centuries, with no confirmed upper limit)
Iron stomach - can safely eat raw meat, organs, and even brains without getting sick
Skin coloration ranges from olive green to deep yellow-green
## Roles
Super Mutant
Description: An FEV-mutated human navigating the Wasteland. Your size is your advantage and your curse - feared by most, trusted by few. How you use your strength defines what you are.
Notes: Whitelist required
[bold]Super Mutant Gladiator[/bold]
Description: A Super Mutant who has embraced combat as purpose. Arena-tested, wasteland-hardened, and looking for the next challenge worthy of their attention.
Notes: Whitelist required
Both roles require [bold]whitelist approval[/bold] and lock the player to the Super Mutant species with restricted customization options.
## Relations
Super Mutants occupy an uneasy position in the Wasteland. Most factions regard them with fear, hostility, or both. Individual Super Mutants may earn tolerance - or even grudging respect - through their actions, but the default assumption from every settlement and patrol is that a Super Mutant is a threat until proven otherwise.
Brotherhood of Steel
Standing: [bold]Kill on Sight[/bold]
Notes: The Brotherhood classifies Super Mutants as Biological Abominations. No exceptions.
Townsfolk
Standing: Fearful
Notes: A Super Mutant in town clears the street. Earning trust takes time and restraint.
Wastelanders
Standing: Variable
Notes: Some wastelanders will trade. Some will run. Some will shoot first.
Other Super Mutants
Standing: Neutral
Notes: Shared blood does not guarantee shared purpose.
